title: Polling and Interrupt Handling
lead: Covers lecture 04, the four polling and interrupt lecture recordings and exercise 3, written for complete beginners: why tasks only seem simultaneous, polling (system 5) and its three problems, interrupts step by step (vector table, stack, ISR, return), ISR rules and volatile, external interrupts INT0/INT1 (system 6), capacitors and debouncing, pin change interrupts (system 7), Arduino attachInterrupt, the click counter, and everything the lecturer added in class (section L).
